prose: In partnership with Music and Sky, The Way Forward and the InnerVerse Podcast, we are proud to present this fireside chat from the Music and Sky Soul Family Gathering that took place Oct. 13th-16th in Cuyama Valley, CA.

Mike was honored to have one of his favorite podcasters, Chance Garton host a spur-of-the-moment podcast-style chat around the Grand Fire Saturday night with three of our all-time favorites: Kelly Brogan, Alec Zeck and Eileen McKusick. They take on a broad range of topics and ideas about the nature of our realm and the role we play as only they can! This was a very special moment for the gathering and we are very happy to be able to share it with you!
